rows.title: A column delete had no Undo (board toast without an action; Project settings with no toast at all)
rows.summary: Now: every column delete, on the board and in Project settings, shows 'Column “X” deleted' with Undo. Undo puts the column back at its place with its title, category and WIP limit, puts each moved issue back (column, resolvedAt, history), and removes a next occurrence the move made for a repeating issue. Edits made after the delete are kept (0c7d6cc, 7dc0318). Since the review (baf3d63), a next occurrence made while the deleted column was still the first to-do column goes into a column that stays on the board, so it is no longer left hidden in a deleted column.
rows.product_call: Undo is on offer while the toast shows and restores only what the delete changed; later edits win. When a delete into Done resolves a repeating issue, its next occurrence goes to the first to-do column left, else the first open column, else the first column. If only a Done column is left, the occurrence is born resolved there, as spawnNext already does on a board with only done columns.

rows.title: A sprint's delete toast offers no Undo
rows.summary: Now: '<Sprint> deleted' offers Undo, which brings the sprint back at its place as it was, with its issues still in the backlog; an active sprint comes back future if another was started meanwhile. A name another sprint took while Undo was on offer gets a free one (8ce3ea0); since the review (acd3c0c), a name another sprint already shared when the sprint was deleted is kept, since the app allows duplicate sprint names.
rows.product_call: Only a clash made after the delete (a new sprint, or a rename to that name) renames the restored sprint: a default name to the next default, any other to ' (2)', ' (3)'.

issues.issue: Undo renamed a restored sprint whenever another sprint had its name, even one that already had it before the delete (duplicate names are allowed by addSprint and renames), so it did not come back as it was.
issues.resolution: Confirmed by reading boardOps.freeSprintName/restoreSprint. Fixed in acd3c0c: removedSprint records the other sprints' names (id -> name) at delete time and freeSprintName ignores a sprint that already had that name then. Three store tests added (shared name kept, shared default-pattern name kept, a rename during the Undo window still a clash). Failfirst 36517478453 green.

issues.issue: deleteColumn moved issues (setStatus, spawning a repeating issue's next occurrence in the first to-do column) before removing the column, so deleting the first to-do column into Done left the next occurrence in the deleted column, hidden on the Board and in the backlog.
issues.resolution: Confirmed by reading boardOps.deleteColumn and boardIssueOps.spawnNext. Fixed in baf3d63: an issue left in the deleted column goes to the column spawnNext would pick without it (first to-do, else first open, else first; resolved if that is done). Undo still removes it. New test file with 3 cases; failfirst 36517478453 green (3 fail without).
